```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)

depts = c("Accountancy", "Economics", "Entrepreneurship", "Finance",
          "Information_Systems_and_Analytics", "Marketing", "Management")

fsb_df = data.frame() # initialize the container

for (dept in depts) {
  dept_url = paste0("https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/", dept, "/all")
  webpage = read_html(dept_url)

  # one table row per person; header rows have no td, so drop them
  all_rows = webpage |> html_elements("table tr")
  rows     = all_rows[!is.na(all_rows |> html_element("td"))]

  # last cell holds the linked name and the position
  person_cell = rows |> html_element("td:last-child")
  name_link   = person_cell |> html_element("a")

  names    = name_link |> html_text2() |> trimws()
  websites = name_link |> html_attr("href")

  # position = cell text minus the name at the start
  cell_text     = person_cell |> html_text2()
  positions_raw = substring(cell_text, nchar(names) + 1)
  positions     = gsub("^[[:punct:][:space:]]+", "", positions_raw) |> trimws()

  # remove trailing link text ("ee" + person's ID)
  junk            = paste0("ee", basename(websites))
  positions_clean = ifelse(endsWith(positions, junk),
                           substr(positions, 1, nchar(positions) - nchar(junk)),
                           positions) |> trimws()

  df = data.frame(department = dept,
                  name       = names,
                  position   = positions_clean,
                  website    = websites)

  fsb_df = rbind(fsb_df, df)
}

head(fsb_df)
table(fsb_df$department)
```
